description: Remove a user's assignment from a customer, revoking their access to the customer's projects and tasks. Requires confirm=true to proceed.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

customer_id.description: Id of the customer to remove the user from.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

org_user_id.description: OrganizationUsers.Id of the member to unassign.

name: remove_user_from_customer
